messages.content: Perform only fact search, as the first stage of symbolic backward chaining. Select verbatim case sentences that directly give the supplied positive goal. Return each selected sentence on its own line, without bullets or explanation. If the goal is not directly given, return exactly No applicable fact. Do not infer a legal qualification from a family relationship, residence, marriage or a statutory subcondition. Fact search and rule search are separate: an inferred goal must be left for rule search. The relation qualifying_child(claimant,subject,year) means the subject is explicitly given as the claimant's qualifying child/dependent under section152(c)(1) for that year. A relationship under section152(c)(2) alone does not give this composite relation. Use the existing TRAIN examples, including the negative examples, to distinguish a direct premise from a possible inference.
